articles.title: “The Vampire Lestat” Date Set, Opening Titles
articles.summary: AMC has officially announced June 7th, 2026, as the premiere date for "The Vampire Lestat." This upcoming run signifies the third season of AMC's acclaimed television adaptation based on Anne Rice's renowned "The Vampire Chronicles" novels, continuing the popular fantasy narrative for viewers. This major release is a key event in the entertainment industry.

articles.title: Blast rocks Tehran amid latest wave of U.S. and Israeli airstrikes
articles.summary: Amid escalating tensions, American and Israeli forces are striking Iran, which is retaliating by attacking shipping and energy infrastructure in the Persian Gulf. U.S. President Donald Trump has issued a new threat to Tehran's leaders, signaling significant regional instability and potential for wider conflict.

articles.title: Turkey says NATO defences intercepted third missile from Iran, asks Tehran to clarify
articles.summary: NATO air defences in the eastern Mediterranean have intercepted a third ballistic missile fired from Iran towards Turkey. The Turkish Defence Ministry confirmed the successful shootdown, highlighting the ongoing tensions and the critical role of NATO's defensive capabilities in safeguarding regional security. This incident underscores the importance of advanced air defence systems in regional stability and collective security measures.

articles.title: Turkiye says NATO defences intercepted third missile from Iran
articles.summary: NATO air defences in the Eastern Mediterranean successfully intercepted a third ballistic missile fired from Iran towards Turkiye, as confirmed by the Turkish Defence Ministry. This incident highlights NATO's robust defensive capabilities and underscores persistent regional tensions. The interception demonstrates the critical role of integrated air defence systems in protecting allied nations against emergent threats, especially in volatile geopolitical scenarios.
